'''Jer al'Hune''' was child that [[Mat Cauthon]] once saved from drowning in the river. 

==History==

[[Egwene al'Vere]] recalls Mat rescuing the boy from the river when she was around 13 or 14 years old ({{ne|995}}). Little Jer was terrified and had slipped below the water without a sound, but Mat had been watching. This gained Mat some respect after having attempting to rescue [[Kiem Lewin]] from the same river the previous year, despite the fact she was not really drowning.{{Ref/book|14|31}}
